title: The Pool Sign Says NOBODY Swims Alone 🏊
description:
At our town pool, you can't swim alone. Someone always swims with you. My grandpa calls it his lane buddy.

This morning at six I had lane four to myself. By lap one, the lap board had a second number on it.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Grandpa's buddy swims BESIDE him. Mine swims a lap BEHIND. Why?
